# airlock_group_baseline_policy (Resource)

Approve an Airlock baseline for a policy group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airlock_group_baseline_policy" "example" {
  group_id  = "1700000004"
  target_id = "1700000006"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Airlock policy group ID.
- `target_id` (String) Baseline ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable Terraform import ID for this Airlock relationship.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import airlock_group_baseline_policy.example 1700000004:1700000006
```
